svg.title: openmeet-providers: provider adapters and the settings-driven factory

g.text: openmeet-providers: provider adapters and the settings-driven factory
-build_llm_for(ctx, component, kind, base_url, model, effort, force_images)
Endpoint is consumed by every adapter's new().
Service decides the API key: OpenAi / Anthropic / OpenAiCompatible
ask SecretResolver; Ollama and LocalAi need none.
endpoint_for fails with BlockedByLocalOnly for a remote URL
build_vision_llm returns Ok(None) for Disabled / OcrOnly.
